findings.description: The separator condition is inverted, changing the help formatting for options with secondary spellings. Preserve the original condition: `"; " if any_prefix_is_slash else " / "`.
findings.rationale: For a boolean option declared as `--foo/--no-foo`, the extracted method now displays `--foo; --no-foo` instead of `--foo / --no-foo`. Slash-prefixed options likewise switch from the semicolon separator to a slash, regressing the existing help output during extraction.
